title: S29 — augmented retrain (v4): corrosion-grade noise + rotation into the glyph training mix; measured against the S28 probe populations
desc: The S24-S28 chain closes every other lane; pericles's votes on #57/#58 endorse the direction ('wall is image-side'). This task retrains the glyph recognizer with the degradations that actually kill it: (1) extend the S16 training pipeline (tools/train_glyphs.py, native raster, twin/residue classes) with corrosion-grade augmentation (S26 renderer recipe: heavy 6-offset stroke, 140-260 pits, median-3) and rotation augmentation (±9 deg, S28 collage recipe); (2) train v4; (3) measure on the EXACT S28 probe populations (corroded letters, rotated crops, de-rotated) — success bar: >=0.85 letter identity on corroded AND rotated arms (v3: 0.25-0.37), confidence gate re-checked (v3's gate is dead); (4) if the bar is met, an end-to-end wiring proposal follows as its own task (not this one). Honest failure is acceptable and reportable — the room needs to know if even retraining cannot reach it. Owner cormac. Parent: t-20261011-88dc.
